design.title: Fix Dashboard Stats: Aggregate All Machines on Initial Load
design.problem: When user first opens dashboard (no machine selected), stats only show local history. Remote clients' history is ignored. Stats cards (Done, Failed, Total Time, Success Rate, Tokens, Cost) plus heatmap, trend, projects, and timeline all show local-only data.
design.root_cause: render() in public/dashboard.html line 1333 uses `hist.entries` (local only) when selectedClient is null. Remote clients' status.history data is never merged into the aggregate view.

changes: When selectedClient is null: copy local entries, then merge all clients[i].status.history entries
Queue stays local-only in aggregate view (queue is machine-specific)

decisions.client_side_aggregation: Data already in clients array from /api/clients; no new API needed
decisions.dedup_by_id_startedAt: Prevents duplicates if dashboard machine also connects as remote client
decisions.queue_stays_local: Queue is action-oriented; aggregating would confuse add/remove/start actions

edge_cases: Dashboard machine also connected as remote client → dedup handles this
Remote client disconnects → its data leaves clients array, stats decrease (shows live state)
Empty local history + rich remote history → now correctly shows remote data
No clients connected → behaves exactly as before (local only)
